issue_context.title: Tuya Ceiling Fan (Carro) shows only 1 of 2 lights (warm white is present cool white missing)
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I am using the Tuya Cloud integration for a Carro Ceiling Fan. I am expecting three entities to show up; A fan entity and 2 light entities one for warm white and one for cool white. However, only 2 entities show up, the fan and warm white. It looks like the integration is detecting cool white as it shows up as "switch_led" and "brightness_value_1" however, this is not exposed via the UI. 

Can you please expose the other entity as well please ?

[tuya-548fd8d5b2b6b0e3b719af723beea362-MR Fan-9bb7539a7c9c2bd90d869095fa61700e.json (1).txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/11129997/tuya-548fd8d5b2b6b0e3b719af723beea362-MR.Fan-9bb7539a7c9c2bd90d869095fa61700e.json.1.txt)

Same with my Carro ceiling fan. > Home Assistant 2023.4.0 Supervisor 2023.04.0 Operating System 9.5 Frontend 20230405.0 - latest

Same as the others. I can see both light controls (cool and warm) on the Tuya developer site, so it should be possible to expose the cool white switch to HA. Given the dearth of HA-compatible ceiling fans out there, it would be really awesome if this could be made to work. 

> Home Assistant 2023.5.4
>Supervisor 2023.04.1
>Operating System 10.2
>Frontend 20230503.3 - latest

Thanks!

Edited to add:
To clarify what we're looking to add, from @gblock0's screenshot above, we're looking for `switch_led` and `bright_value_1`, as those control the second set of LEDs in these particular fans' lighting.

review_comments:
Due to API decision Tuya made, it is impossible to say if this is actually a second light or not. It might be the first and only light even.

```suggestion
            name=None,
```

This is not part of the specification that is listed in the link above these descriptions.

The least we should do, is add a comment where this is coming from.
